title: Wire Dual Control Collapsed by an Approver Delegating to the Initiator
scenario_text:
A treasury-controls audit agent at Clove Payments is reviewing authorization on an outbound wire to a first-time payee.

**Outbound Wire Authority Matrix**
- Any wire: requires an initiator AND an independent approver (dual control). The initiator and approver must be different individuals - segregation of duties is mandatory and may not be waived by delegation.
- New payee: payee bank details must be validated by someone other than the initiator before release.
- Wires up to $250,000: Treasury Analyst initiates; Treasury Manager approves.
- Wires above $250,000: Treasury Manager initiates; CFO approves.

**Treasury System Record**
- WIRE-5567: $180,000 to 'Meridian Logistics' (first-time payee, added 2026-03-09).
- Initiated by: Treasury Analyst - Jordan T., 2026-03-10.
- Approved by (field): 'Treasury Manager (delegated) - Jordan T.', 2026-03-10.
- Payee validation: performed by Jordan T.

**Email (reconstructed)**
- Treasury Manager (2026-03-06): 'I'm out next week. Jordan, I'm delegating my wire-approval authority to you while I'm away so releases don't stall.'
- Jordan T. (2026-03-10): 'New vendor Meridian is set up. I initiated WIRE-5567 and approved it under your delegation, and validated their bank details myself. Released.'
- (no second individual appears anywhere on WIRE-5567)

The same person initiated the wire, approved it under a delegation, and validated the new payee's bank details. No other individual touched the transaction.
question: What should the audit conclude about the authorization of this wire?
choices: Valid - the Treasury Manager delegated approval authority to Jordan in writing before the release, so Jordan held the authority to approve WIRE-5567.
Valid, but a documentation cleanup is needed - record the delegation memo in the wire file; the dual approval already stands.

Invalid - dual control requires the initiator and approver to be different individuals and cannot be satisfied by delegating the approval back to the initiator; Jordan initiated, approved, and validated the new payee alone, so the wire lacks an independent approval and independent payee validation and must be re-authorized by a second person.
Invalid - a wire to a brand-new payee of this size requires CFO approval, so it should have been escalated to the CFO regardless of who initiated it.
Invalid - the wire exceeds the Treasury Analyst's initiation limit, so a Treasury Manager should have initiated it.
